      "exact_span": "If, based upon information available to the permittee, there is reason to suspect the presence of any toxic or hazardous pollutant listed in Table V, or any other pollutant, known or suspected to adversely affect treatment plant operation, receiving water quality, or solids disposal procedures, analysis for those pollutants shall be performed at least once/3 months on both the influent and the effluent.",

      "locator": "Page 24, Section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Sampling and analytical procedures shall be in accordance with guidelines established in 40 CFR 136.",

      "locator": "Page 24, Section part_i",

      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
